purpose: Freeze a single target-blind SPIn component replacement: keep the accepted exact-adjoint observation, C-RADIO relation cache, Euclidean K201 topology, and frozen evaluator, while replacing release reachability with a continuous convex Evidence-to-Support solver that locks reliable reference observations.
claim_scope_reason: lego, truck, and room were selected after the complete SPIn9 result was opened; they cannot serve as independent confirmation scenes.

single_registered_configuration.reference_observation: native exact front-to-back raster adjoint of the declared full binary reference mask
single_registered_configuration.observation_probability: y_obs=m_fg/(m_fg+m_bg) for observed rows; unobserved rows use query compatibility P
single_registered_configuration.observation_confidence: c_obs=(m_fg+m_bg)/m_vis; because SPIn supplies a full binary mask this is one for every visible row and zero for invisible rows

query_compatibility.model: balanced logistic regression on every nonzero signed reference observation
query_compatibility.relation: existing deterministic signed-hash256 projection of canonical C-RADIO to DINO capability

graph.topology: existing exact Euclidean K200 plus self cache
graph.base_affinity: continuous DINO RBF with reference-positive median scale
graph.query_gate: sqrt(P_i*P_j) applied only to pairwise conductance
graph.normalization: symmetric endpoint-degree normalization after query gating

hard_reference_lock.conflict_policy: no row can satisfy both inequalities

linear_solver.algorithm: Jacobi-preconditioned conjugate gradient on free rows

single_registered_configuration.rendered_threshold: select one threshold from 0.99 down to 0.03 in steps of 0.01 using only the declared reference mask, then seal it before target scoring

thermal_policy.polling_policy: low-frequency thermal guard only; no frequent external polling
